'''Necil Sing''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], she visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] in on that planet. During her visit, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] hid in the club from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Sing walked by Skywalker while he searched for Wesell, who was eventually found and apprehended.

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Necil Sing was a native of<ref name="DB" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> she<ref name="Insider" /> was a patron of the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="DB" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> during the [[Local day/Legends|night]] of the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|attempted assassination]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="AOTC" />

After the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], ran into the club, Sing talked with a Human next to<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> a [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]]<ref name="Complete Locations" /> when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered searching for Wesell. She continued to stay close to the Human as Kenobi drank at the club's bar. The woman later walked alone through the club, eventually making her way past Skywalker as he surveyed the crowd. After Kenobi [[Dismemberment/Legends|slashed]] Wesell with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Sing was stood with another Human near the entrance while the Jedi escorted the apprehended bounty hunter out of the nightclub.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Personality and traits==
Sing had [[Color/Legends|dark]] skin, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]]<ref name="DB" /> worn up in a conical hairstyle.<ref name="AOTC" /> "Necil" was a feminine name of Human origin.<ref name="GalacticCampaign">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> 

==Equipment==
During her visit to the Outlander, she wore a dark, sleaveless [[Clothing/Legends|dress]]<ref name="AOTC" /> and a beaded silver veil.<ref name="Insider" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Necil Sing wears a beaded veil and walks across the frame after Hayde Gofai's stare. She can be seen without her veil in the ''On Location [sic]'' segment entitled "In the Money." If you flip the letters, her name spells "Licensing."|[[Daniel Wallace]]|<ref name="Insider" />}}
[[File:NecilSing-onlocation.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Necil Sing was first revealed when the extra portraying the character introduced the ninth episode of ''on location''.]]
Necil Sing first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes including Sing, who was portrayed by uncredited extra,<ref name="AOTC" /> were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The extra playing the character, in costume, introduced the ninth episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series [[On location|''on location'']].<ref name="On location">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/9.html|series=On Location|text=Part 9 - In the Money}}</ref> The episode, "In The Money," released on [[September 9]], [[2000]].<ref name="Archive">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/onloc/archive.html|text=''on location'' archive}}</ref> 

Sing was first identified in an Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on [[StarWars.com]] that could be accessed through the DVD-ROM home release of Attack of the Clones<ref name="DepthCommentary">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> on [[November 12]], 2002.<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref> The character's name is anagram for "licensing."<ref name="Insider" />
